title: [Master] - Slice 626320: [Self-billing][VENDOR] Vendor‑specific Number Series for Self‑Billed Purchase Invoices
summary: Vendors can now specify a number series for self-billed purchase invoices, allowing different numbering schemes based on the vendor. The feature is implemented through new table fields, posting logic updates, and vendor card UI enhancements across all localized versions.
key_points: New field on the Vendor table for a self-billed purchase invoice number series
Purchase posting changed to use the vendor-specific number series for self-billed invoices
Vendor Card page shows the new number series setting
Changes are spread across many localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU and others), though not every layer changes posting
Tests added in the W1, US and CA purchase document test codeunits
